title: Dual-rail translation
statement: For a natural number $n$, an input index $i_0  in  br^n$ (that is, an element of $	ext{Fin}(n)$), and a list of gates, the dual-rail translation is the pair of statement and rail lists obtained by folding the gate-by-gate translation over that list. The fold starts with no statements and, for each input $k$, the rail pair consisting of $x_k$ and its negation.
caveat: The statement depends on the omitted definition of the gate-by-gate step `dualStep`, so its precise translation of each gate cannot be specified from the supplied text.
